text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hah—hah—damn it...! Talk about an absurd 
amount of pressure, man...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Locked on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Haaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Symboli Kris S! She's moving 
up!! Surging straight into the lead--!! 
She crosses the line!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: H-Haha...!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...! I lost, I losttttt!! 
Aaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Tap.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I really thought I could pull off the 
greatest run of my life. Even with all 
that, it still wasn't enough, huh—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —But, this isn't the end.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I should be thanking you, 
Kris S. Because of you, I realized I can 
burn even hotter than this!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“—The final destination of the Autumn 
Senior Triple Crown, the Arima Kinen. 
That's where I'm finally gonna beat you!”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Haha, this is getting thrilling! Let's 
meet next at year-end Nakayama—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was so thrilling! Tap was so 
close, but Kris S really is the strongest, 
huh!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The races lately have seriously had so 
many legendary showdowns, it's crazy 
hype!! I'm super pumped for the Arima 
Kinen too~!

"...I heard it. That sweet, resounding 
sound of the chains of fate binding us 
being severed—"

Do as you are guided, and indulge in all 
manner of tyranny! Indeed. For the future 
does not belong to the world—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S, victorious after a fierce 
battle. On her face, a faint hint of 
something resembling accomplishment could 
be seen—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It felt tangible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In order to become an "ordeal"— once more, 
facing Tap...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That her passion... will only burn hotter.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The stronger I am―― the more Tap's passion 
will blaze――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...I have obtained... that certainty."
choice_data_list: Next, let's set the entire era ablaze!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —And for that sake...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen... I will win. Without 
fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To stand at the peak of this era and 
become the ultimate 'trial'—she begins her 
march toward the final showdown, the Arima 
Kinen...!"
